name: Seminar: Science and Ethics
description:
- Biographies of distinguished scientists (J. Robert, Oppenheimer, Kurt Gödel, ...) 
- Classical scientific dilemmas/debates (cloning, genetics research, equality in science, ...)
- Ethics in Computer Science (privacy, big data, Open Source, ...)
- Science and society (COVID-19 restrictions, science and politics, ...)
- Good Scientific Practice (reproducibility, fraud, plagiarism, ...)
